page.title: Automations
page.subtitle: Create workflows that run your agents automatically on a schedule or in response to events.

empty.title: No automations yet
empty.description: Automations run your agents automatically on a schedule or when something happens. Create your first one to get started.

runs.title: All Runs
runs.noRuns: No runs found across your automations.

subtitle.create: Set up an automated workflow that runs your agent on a schedule or in response to events.

schedule.title: On a schedule
schedule.description: Run your agent automatically at set times — daily, weekly, or on a custom schedule.

event.title: When something happens
event.description: Run your agent when an event occurs, like a new email arrives.
event.triggersDisabled: Event triggers aren't enabled for your account yet. Contact your admin to turn them on.
event.gmailNotConnected: Connect your Gmail account in Data Connectors to use email triggers.

builder.title: Set up the trigger
builder.subtitle: Choose what events should fire this automation, and optionally filter them.
builder.filterRequired: Add at least one filter so this automation only runs on relevant emails.
builder.includeContext: Include email content in the agent prompt
builder.includeContextHelp: When enabled, the full email (subject, sender, body, attachments) is automatically passed to the agent so it can read and act on it. Turn off if you only want to pass specific fields via variables.

schedule.title: Set the schedule
schedule.subtitle: Choose when and how often your automation should run.

agent.title: Choose an agent
agent.subtitle: Select the agent that will run when this automation fires.
agent.empty: No agents found. Create an agent first to use in automations.

prompt.title: Configure details
prompt.subtitle: Give your automation a name and optional instructions for the agent.

name.label: Automation name
name.placeholder: e.g. Weekly sales report, Daily email digest

instructions.label: Instructions (optional)
instructions.placeholder: Tell the agent what to do when this automation runs. You can include output instructions like 'email the results to team@company.com when done'.
instructions.help: These instructions are sent to the agent each time the automation runs, in addition to the agent's built-in prompt.

maxRuns.label: Maximum runs
maxRuns.help: The automation will pause once it has run this many times. Maximum 100.

emailNotifications.label: Send email notifications when this automation runs

review.title: Review your automation
review.subtitle: Check everything looks right before saving.

history.title: Run History
history.empty: No runs yet. This automation hasn't been triggered.

confirm.deleteDescription: This will permanently remove this automation and its schedule. Run history will be preserved.

unavailable.pipedreamDisabled: Pipedream integrations are disabled for this workspace. Contact your admin to enable them.

gmail.label: Gmail
gmail.description: Trigger on new emails, with optional filters on sender, subject, body, or attachments.

slack.label: Slack
slack.description: Trigger on keyword mentions, @-mentions, new messages, or reactions in your channels.

propRenderer.unsupportedType: Field type "{{type}}" is not yet supported in this builder.

configurator.noTriggersAvailable: No triggers are configured for this app yet.
configurator.unknownApp: This app isn't in the curated trigger registry.

eventTrigger.pickSource: Pick where the event comes from.

detail.unhealthyBody: This automation's underlying connection isn't healthy — events won't fire until you reconnect the app.

slack.label: Slack
slack.description: Trigger on keyword mentions, @-mentions, new messages, or reactions in your channels.

slack-new-keyword-mention.label: When a keyword is mentioned
slack-new-keyword-mention.description: Fires when a message in your selected channels contains a keyword (e.g. "@Numa").

conversations.label: Channels
conversations.description: Channels to monitor. Only messages in these channels are watched.

keyword.label: Keyword
keyword.description: Fires when a message contains this exact keyword (case-insensitive). Use a unique word like "@Numa" so you don't trigger on every casual mention.

slack-new-user-mention.label: When a user is @-mentioned
slack-new-user-mention.description: Fires when a specific user is @-mentioned in your selected channels.

conversations.label: Channels
conversations.description: Channels to monitor for @-mentions of the selected user.

user.label: User to watch
user.description: Fires when this user is @-mentioned in any of the selected channels.

slack-new-message-in-channels.label: When a message is posted
slack-new-message-in-channels.description: Fires on every new message in the channels you pick. High volume — use carefully.

conversations.label: Channels
conversations.description: Channels to monitor. Every message in these channels will fire the automation.

slack-new-reaction-added.label: When a reaction is added
slack-new-reaction-added.description: Fires when a member reacts to a message in selected channels.

conversations.label: Channels
conversations.description: Channels to monitor for new reactions.
